privacy.collect.text: None. Fiscal has no account sign-up, no advertising, no analytics or crash-reporting SDKs and no tracking across apps or websites.
privacy.collect.title: Data we collect
privacy.delete.text: You can manage storage for Fiscal in your device's iCloud settings. Deleting the app removes local data.
privacy.delete.title: Deleting your data
privacy.diagnostics.text: If you choose to share analytics with app developers in your device settings, Apple may provide us with aggregated, anonymous usage and crash data through App Store Connect.
privacy.diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
privacy.lead: Fiscal is an app made by Rafael Escaleira (byescaleira). Your data belongs to you: it stays on your devices and in your own iCloud account. We do not run servers that receive it, and we never see it.
privacy.meta.description: How Fiscal handles your data: it stays on your devices and in your own iCloud.
privacy.meta.title: Fiscal Privacy Policy
privacy.network.purchases: Purchases. Subscriptions and in-app purchases are handled by Apple through the App Store. We do not receive your payment details.
privacy.network.settings: App settings. Fiscal reads feature settings from a public iCloud database. Nothing about you is sent.
privacy.network.title: Network requests the app makes
privacy.network.web: Fiscal on the Web (optional, Fiscal Pro). If you scan the QR code shown at fiscal.byescaleira.com/app, Fiscal sends a summary of your data, encrypted end to end for the browser whose QR code you scanned, through our bridge at fiscal.byescaleira.com. The bridge keeps it for at most 24 hours and cannot read it; only that browser can open it. Disconnect in Settings deletes it right away. The App Store label stays "Data Not Collected" because neither we nor any third party can access the content.
privacy.where.device: On your device. Your items and settings are stored locally.
privacy.where.icloud: In your iCloud. If iCloud is on, Fiscal syncs that data through your private iCloud database. Apple stores it under your Apple Account; we cannot access it.
privacy.where.title: Where your data lives

terms.pro.billing: Fiscal Pro is an auto-renewable subscription, billed monthly or yearly at the price shown in the app before you subscribe.
terms.pro.end: When a subscription ends, your data stays yours: everything you recorded remains readable and editable.
terms.pro.features: The everyday features of Fiscal are free. Fiscal Pro adds Fiscal on the Web, exclusive app icons and the other Pro features listed in the app.
terms.pro.renewal: The subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel it in your Apple Account subscription settings.
terms.pro.trial: Eligible new subscribers get a 7-day free trial. If you do not cancel at least 24 hours before it ends, the subscription starts and your Apple Account is charged.
terms.purchases.apple: Payments, refunds and restores are handled by Apple under the App Store's terms.
